patterns: APPSC asks species-to-sanctuary one-liners and matches: Koundinya = elephants, Coringa = saltwater crocodile, Rollapadu = GIB, Sri Lankamalleswara = Jerdon's courser, Gundla Brahmeswaram = tiger.
Chronology of notification (Nelapattu > Rollapadu > Kaundinya > Kolleru) and counts ('13 WLS as of 2019') are recurring shapes.
Traps: 'NOT a sanctuary in AP' with out-of-state distractors (Chinnar), Kolleru wrongly paired with Krishna river, Telineelapuram pelican mortality.
Many filed PYQs are pan-India PA locations; app instead goes deep into AP district reassignments, areas and survey figures.
